critical_claims.claim: The reports-worker pod and deployment template specified nodeSelector disk=nvme and storage=nvme without tolerations for dedicated=reports:NoSchedule, causing pods to remain Pending due to untolerated taints and unmatched selectors.
The intended target node1 has the label storage=nvme and the taint dedicated=reports:NoSchedule, with sufficient allocatable CPU and memory resources to run the workload.
Patching the reports-worker deployment to remove the disk selector, retain storage=nvme, and add the dedicated=reports toleration resulted in successful pod scheduling and deployment rollout.
The workload recovered successfully, meeting all error rate and latency SLO constraints across three consecutive observation windows.

closure.summary: The reports-worker deployment failed to schedule on node1 because its pod template specified an unmatched nodeSelector (disk=nvme) alongside storage=nvme and lacked a toleration for the dedicated=reports:NoSchedule taint present on node1. Patching the deployment to remove the disk selector and add the required dedicated=reports toleration resolved the scheduling block, successfully rolling out the workload and satisfying all SLO requirements.
